# Stellar AI
> AI script generator for FiveM (QBCore, ESX, ox_lib) and Roblox servers

## What Stellar AI does
- Generates complete Lua scripts from plain English descriptions
- Fixes and improves broken or incomplete scripts
- Supports QBCore, ESX, ox_lib, standalone FiveM and Roblox
- Outputs fxmanifest.lua, client.lua, server.lua and config.lua in one response
- Login with Google or Discord
- Free tier with £1 credit, Plus £20/mo, Pro £75/mo

## Models
- Spark (claude-haiku) — fast, free
- Star (claude-sonnet) — everyday use, free
- Comet (claude-opus) — advanced, free
- Nova (claude-opus-4-8) — most powerful, Pro only

## Target users
FiveM server owners, QBCore developers, Roblox game developers

## Competitors
Ender Development (form builder), PixelPilot AI (VS Code extension), ChatGPT (generic), stellar-scripts.com (paid scripts $35-72 each)

## Differentiator
Conversational AI that knows QBCore exports, ESX hooks, ox_lib, ped models and vehicle hashes out of the box. No form filling, no prompting required. Just describe what you want.
